description: Byte copy of the full SW2021 level-1 PIT membership table as returned by pro.index_member_all(l1_code=..., is_new in {Y,N}) on 2026-09-15, fetched because the cache in use was built from pro.index_member(index_code=...), which clamps every STAR-Market in_date to 2023-09-25. Vendored so the feasibility finding can be re-checked offline against the vendor's answer as it stood on this date, and so a later refetch that differs is a measurable event rather than a memory.
api: pro.index_member_all(l1_code=<each of the 31 SW2021 L1 codes>, is_new in {'Y','N'})
